source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.leaves: 3–7 leaflets, 10–25 mm long, glabrous or sparsely pubescent
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Spikes usually 10–14 mm thick (thinner on small regrowth after mowing)

cautions: Only var. pubescens treated in Flora; do not generalize all measurements to species-level Dalea compacta
Kew POWO recognizes Dalea compacta and var. pubescens as accepted taxon concepts
Does not establish Hays County occurrence or nativity; do not export to identification scoring without taxon review
